description: The file contains a Python class 'AnalyzerService' responsible for analyzing uploaded assets in a branding compliance project. It performs detection of old logos within images and PDFs, generates overlay previews, manages asset states, and saves detection results. The class interacts with other modules like VisionUtils, models (Asset, Issue), and storage mechanisms to facilitate comprehensive analysis workflows.

classes.name: AnalyzerService
classes.description: Performs analysis for a job's uploaded assets using CV detection utilities to identify old logos, generate overlays, and save detection data.

methods.name: None __init__(self, state_store: StateStore)
methods.description: Initializes the AnalyzerService with a given state store.

methods.name: AssetType _detect_asset_type(self, path: Path)
methods.description: Detects the asset type based on file extension.

methods.name: List[Path] _list_uploaded_files(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Lists uploaded files for a given job.

methods.name: List[Asset] _ensure_assets_list(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Builds and registers asset models from uploaded files if not already registered.

methods.name: Path|None _choose_old_logo_template(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Selects the first uploaded old brand image as a template for detection.

methods.name: Path _save_detections(self, job_id: str, det_map: Dict[str, List[Detection]])
methods.description: Saves detection results as a JSON file.

methods.name: None _overlay_preview(self, job_id: str, asset_path: Path, detections: List[Detection], page_index: int | None = None)
methods.description: Creates an overlay PNG with detection rectangles and labels.

methods.name: None analyze_job(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Performs detailed analysis on all assets of a job, detects old logos, generates overlays, and records issues and detections.

methods.name: None generate_previews(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Marks that previews are generated by creating a timestamp file.
